title: The same closed-gradient resolvent satisfies the weighted distributional equation
source_anchor: arXiv:2609.06905v1 Appendix C.1 analytic prerequisite; weighted Poisson/Sobolev background1310.2526v7 sections2.4-2.5
target_statement: For C1 W with integrable exp(-W), any same closable exact compact smooth gradient D and epsilon>0, every L2 forcing has a D.closure-domain weak solution whose ordinary weak gradient is D.closure u and whose smooth compact tests satisfy epsilon integral exp(-W)u psi + integral exp(-W)<D.closure u,gradient psi> = integral exp(-W)f psi, all three products integrable. Retain its entire abstract weak equation.
